description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'Tenants' which provides static methods to create 'Tenant' objects based on trust anchors such as X509 certificates. It encapsulates logic for constructing tenant representations, including handling certificate attributes and validity periods.

classes.name: Tenants
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for creating Tenant objects from trust anchors, including X509 certificates and related data.

methods.name: createTenantForTrustAnchor (X509Certificate cert)
methods.description: Creates a Tenant object from an X509Certificate trust anchor, extracting the subject DN and public key.

methods.name: createTenantForTrustAnchor (X500Principal subjectDn, PublicKey publicKey)
methods.description: Creates a Tenant object from a distinguished name and public key, delegating to the more detailed method.

methods.name: createTenantForTrustAnchor (String subjectDn, byte[] publicKey, String algorithm)
methods.description: Creates a Tenant object using explicit trust anchor details, sets default validity period to one year.

methods.name: createTenantForTrustAnchor (String subjectDn, byte[] publicKey, String algorithm, Instant notBefore, Instant notAfter)
methods.description: Creates a Tenant with specified trust anchor details and validity period, constructs a TrustedCertificateAuthority object and assigns it to a new Tenant.
